---
title: Code block style, filename bar on a dark page
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

The brand gives the page a dark background, and the style keeps `stroke`, `surface` and `label` at `auto`.
The filename bar, its label and the frame must take the dark-page colours.

```{=typst}
#show "example.py": it => context {
  if text.fill == luma(225) { counter("cbs-label").step() }
  it
}
#show block: it => {
  if it.fill == luma(55) { counter("cbs-surface").step() }
  if type(it.stroke) == stroke and it.stroke.paint == luma(100) { counter("cbs-frame").step() }
  it
}
```

```{.python filename="example.py"}
x = 1
```

```{=typst}
#context {
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-surface").final().first(), 1, message: "expected 1 filename bar with the dark-page surface")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-label").final().first(), 1, message: "expected the filename in the dark-page label colour")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-frame").final().first(), 1, message: "expected the frame in the dark-page stroke")
}
```
